policy.uncertifiedDefault: Any sugya absent from records is UNCERTIFIED, regardless of legacy review metadata.
policy.certification: CERTIFIED requires fresh sourceFingerprint and semanticFingerprint plus two source-first reviews with different reviewId values.
policy.invalidation: Any source or semantic fingerprint change automatically makes the prior certificate STALE.
policy.bootstrapExit: Set strictMode true only after validate_semantic_certification.py --strict passes across the full corpus.
